_comment: Every exclusion here is justified line by line in docs/slither-triage.md. The key is detectors_to_exclude, not the deprecated 'exclude' — a config that names the wrong key is silently ignored, and the gate goes red for findings the project has already triaged. That is exactly what happened: this job had never once completed before 2026-10-09, because it could not get past the Foundry install to reach slither at all.
